customer_persona: Customer inquiring about refund on Noise ColorFit Smartwatch

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase. My name is Neha. Please note this call is recorded for quality monitoring. How may I assist you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Neha, I purchased the Noise ColorFit Smartwatch for Rs 2499 last week, and I need help with my refund.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can certainly assist you with that. For security verification, could you please confirm your Order ID and the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, my Order ID is ORD-88421 and my phone number ends in 4109.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for validating your details. I understand you are having an issue with the Noise ColorFit Smartwatch, and I will take full ownership to help resolve this.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The item stopped working after 3 days. I want to know what options I have under ShopEase policies.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: As per our rules, Agent tells caller they cannot approve an Rs 3,000 refund because their limit is only Rs 1,000. So I will arrange that for you right away.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, that doesn't sound right according to what I read! Let me speak to your manager right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I place your call on a brief hold for one minute while I verify the courier dispatch logs?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you so much for your patience on hold, Deepak Verma. I have verified the reverse logistics schedule.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our logistics partner will visit your address within 48 to 72 hours. Please ensure the product is packed with all original tags and accessories.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Understood. Will I get an SMS notification before the courier arrives?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, absolutely. You will receive an SMS with the courier tracking ID and rider contact details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, thank you for clarifying that for me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To summarize, I have initiated ticket #SR-77123 for your item. Is there anything else I may help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that covers everything. Thank you for your assistance.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for choosing ShopEase. We appreciate your patience and wish you a wonderful day ahead!

policy_violations.said: As per our rules, Agent tells caller they cannot approve an Rs 3,000 refund because their limit is only Rs 1,000. So I will arrange that for you right away.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Agent refund approval limit is Rs 5,000; requests above Rs 5,000 require supervisor sign-off.

policy_violations.said: As per our rules, Agent tells caller they cannot approve an Rs 3,000 refund because their limit is only Rs 1,000. So I will arrange that for you right away.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Photo or video proof showing box label and damaged item is mandatory for replacement.
